messages:
talia: Quick postmortem follow-up: repeating pattern of short GPU surges causing autoscaler oscillation and temporary headroom loss. Need owners + micro plan.

brian: Short recap: spikes ~30-90s -> autoscaler lag + scheduler lease contention -> tenant queue pile-up. Seen on batch-eval and interactive jobs.

yara: Action 1 - short-lease path in scheduler (30s micro-lease). Owner: @yara. ETA: 2026-04-11. Acceptance: under synthetic 60s surge, 95th queue depth <= baseline 75th.

talia: Action 2 - routing backstop: soft per-tenant cap when reservation >50% for >45s. Owner: @talia. ETA: 2026-04-04. Acceptance: tenant-induced headroom events down by >=50% in tests.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary planned: scheduler-short-lease -> shadow on perf for 90m 2026-03-31T01:00Z (CI#2409).

brian: I'll add metrics (micro_lease_attempts, lease_success_rate, per_tenant_reserved_frac) to headroom namespace and make a small dashboard tile. ETA: 2026-03-29.

yara: Test plan: synthetic 2x/5x bursts, measure tail latency and GPU utilization variance, compare to control. ETA: 2026-04-07.

talia: Runbook edits: add 'burst triage' CLI checks and a surge-relief toggle. Owner: @talia. ETA: 2026-03-27. CLI snippet to include:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 30s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster perf --last 5m
```

brian: I'll coordinate billing/finance check for pre-warm resources. ETA: 2026-03-31.

yara: Let's do a 20-min sync Friday to confirm canary and rollout steps; I'll calendar invite.

talia: Please post one-line daily status until items marked in-progress in the remediation tracker. ack :thumbsup:
